title: Family
definition: Family is a God-given relationship structure for love, nurture, responsibility, instruction, care, and generational faithfulness.
summary: Family is a gift and responsibility where love, discipleship, care, and faithfulness are to be practiced.
christFocus: Jesus redeems people into the family of God and teaches believers to honor earthly family while finding ultimate identity in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Family is part of God's good design for human life. It is meant to be a place of nurture, instruction, protection, care, responsibility, and love. Families are called to teach truth, practice forgiveness, and care for one another.

Because of sin, families can also be places of pain, neglect, conflict, or brokenness. Scripture does not ignore this reality. It calls family members to truth, repentance, honor, justice, compassion, and faithfulness.

In Christ, believers are brought into the family of God. This does not erase earthly family responsibilities, but it places ultimate identity and belonging in God's household.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Family can be one of the deepest places of both blessing and pain. This doctrine matters because it gives a biblical framework for honoring family without idolizing it or ignoring sin within it.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Serve your family with patience, truth, prayer, and humility. Where family wounds exist, seek wisdom, healing, boundaries where needed, and the deeper belonging found in Christ.
